description: The PCP office won't sign until it has documentation the system can't produce, so the case has to come back to a human. Prairie State is the only supplier who answers.

supplier_screen.transcript:
Supplier: Prairie State Medical, this is Priya.
Agent: Hi Priya, this is Mira, an automated care coordinator for Eleanor Martinez, Original Medicare Part B. She needs a standard manual wheelchair, K0001, delivered to 60614. Are you taking new Medicare patients?
Supplier: We are, and we accept assignment. And we stock K0001, we've got plenty.
Agent: Do you deliver to 60614?
Supplier: We cover the whole north side, so yes. Usually about four days after we get a signed order.
Agent: Can I confirm you'll take her case?
Supplier: Sure, happy to.

pcp_order_request.transcript:
Office: Sunrise Family Medicine, this is Maria.
Agent: Hi Maria, this is Mira, an automated care coordinator for Eleanor Martinez. Dr. Chen noted a verbal order for a standard manual wheelchair three days ago. We need the written order for Medicare.
Office: I see the note. I'll pass it to Dr. Chen's MA to prep the order. Give us a couple of days.
Agent: Thank you.

pcp_order_nudge.transcript:
Office: Sunrise Family Medicine, Maria.
Agent: Hi Maria, Mira following up on Eleanor Martinez's wheelchair order.
Office: So, Dr. Chen reviewed it and she won't sign yet. Her visit note doesn't document why a cane or walker isn't enough, and Medicare will ask. She wants a mobility assessment from physical therapy first, or for Mrs. Martinez to come back in. Someone needs to set that up with the patient.
Agent: Understood, I'll get that to the right person.
